s.n: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
s.note: Chickpea hummus and smoky eggplant dip, flatbread, dukkah, olives, cucumber
s.how: Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

s.note: Egyptian fava bean falafel in flatbread with tahini sauce and pickles.
s.how: Soak 400g dried split fava beans (or chickpeas) overnight, drain and blitz with 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 bunch each of parsley and coriander, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander and 1 tsp salt to a rough green paste. Rest 10 minutes, shape into 16 patties, shallow fry in 2cm of oil at 180C for 3 minutes a side until deep golden. Stuff 4 flatbreads with the ta'amiya, tahini sauce (4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water to loosen), tomato and pickles.

m.n: Corned beef and onion hash with army biscuits
m.note: Tinned corned beef, potato and onion fried crisp, plain biscuits alongside.
m.how: Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender and drain well. Fry 2 sliced onions in 2 tbsp oil and 30g butter for 10 minutes until golden, add the potatoes and 2 x 300g tins of corned beef broken up with a fork, and press down. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning once, until crusty with a splash of Worcestershire sauce. Serve with fried eggs, mustard, and plain water crackers or hard plain biscuits.

w.note: Semolina cake soaked in lemon syrup, topped with an almond, with cream.
w.how: Mix 250g fine semolina, 100g desiccated coconut, 100g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 150g plain yoghurt and 120g melted butter into a thick batter and rest 10 minutes. Press into a greased 20cm square tin, cut into diamonds, press an almond into each and bake at 180C for 30 minutes until golden. Boil 250g sugar, 250ml water and the juice of half a lemon for 8 minutes, pour the cool syrup over the hot cake and rest for 10 minutes before serving.

w.note: Crisp oat and coconut biscuits sweetened with golden syrup
w.how: Mix 90g oats, 150g flour, 85g coconut and 150g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then add 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water. Stir together, roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160C for 15 minutes.

d.note: Strong black tea with condensed milk, poured into tin mugs.
d.how: Boil 1.2 litres of water, pour over 6 black tea bags in a large pot and steep for 5 minutes. Stir 4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk through the pot until dissolved and serve in tin mugs or sturdy enamel mugs.
